model_surface.important_distinction: RewardGold/RewardDust/SpendGold are in the AIM function table. onSetGold/onSetHealth/onSetMana/onSetLevel/onStatIncrease are handlers. They are not interchangeable solely because their names are similar.

native_function_audit.name: uai_gp_hud::RewardGold(S3DX::AIVariable)
observed_body_evidence: Performs numeric parsing and floating-point addition between the supplied amount and a retrieved current numeric value.
Uses the HUD model's runtime/API call surface and formats/publishes Gold display values with UseCommas, NumberToString and Concat.
native_function_audit.decision: Keep only as a separate, fixed-effect candidate. Do not map it to economy.currency_override (set-to-target) or a multiplier control.

native_function_audit.name: uai_gp_hud::RewardDust(S3DX::AIVariable)
observed_body_evidence: Accepts one AIVariable argument and has a distinct native function entry from RewardGold.
native_function_audit.decision: Do not map by analogy to Gold, Crystal, or Adventure Marks. Recover the exact state key and call preconditions first.

native_function_audit.name: uai_gp_hud::SpendGold(S3DX::AIVariable)
observed_body_evidence: Its call context includes existing LegendEx/debug behavior; the state/persistence and negative-balance preconditions have not been fully specified in this pass.
native_function_audit.decision: Do not expose as a general arbitrary spend or balance setter.

native_function_audit.name: uai_gp_hud::onSetGold(int, S3DX::AIVariable const*, S3DX::AIVariable*)
observed_body_evidence: Formats the passed numeric value through NumberToString and Concat.
Passes the formatted result through an indirect model/UI call.
No direct call to RewardGold or SpendGold appears in this function body.
native_function_audit.decision: Do not label this handler as a setter for the authoritative Gold balance.

native_function_audit.name: uai_gp_hud::onSetHealth(int, S3DX::AIVariable const*, S3DX::AIVariable*)
observed_body_evidence: Parses two numeric-like AIVariable inputs and computes a ratio before passing the result to an indirect model/API call.
No direct, statically named authoritative health setter is called in this body.
native_function_audit.decision: Do not map to player.health_multiplier, player.health_percent_range, God Mode or No Death without a recovered argument/state contract.

native_function_audit.name: uai_gp_hud::onSetMana(int, S3DX::AIVariable const*, S3DX::AIVariable*)
observed_body_evidence: Parses two numeric-like AIVariable inputs and computes a ratio before passing the result to an indirect model/API call.
No direct, statically named authoritative mana setter is called in this body.
native_function_audit.decision: Do not map to player.infinite_mana or player.mana_regen_multiplier by name similarity.

native_function_audit.name: uai_gp_hud::onSetLevel(int, S3DX::AIVariable const*, S3DX::AIVariable*)
observed_body_evidence: Retrieves a value, formats/concatenates it, and forwards a string through an indirect model/UI call.
No direct call to a level mutation API is present in this handler body.

native_function_audit.name: uai_gp_hud::onStatIncrease(int, S3DX::AIVariable const*, S3DX::AIVariable*)
observed_body_evidence: Contains a large multi-branch stat-upgrade flow with repeated model-variable reads/writes and contextual state checks.
native_function_audit.decision: Do not repurpose the existing stat-upgrade workflow as independent arbitrary stat setters.

scope_limitations: This is static AArch64 disassembly plus AIM name-table correlation, not live execution or an engine-debugger trace.
Indirect calls are not assigned a semantic name from their vtable offset alone.
The existence of a function in the AIM function table does not prove an arbitrary HUD action can invoke it safely.
No game assets, native library, APK, or XAPK were changed or built in this increment.
